admin.title: Analytics
admin.botActionsHint: Telegram bot events are counted separately from activity inside the site.
admin.retentionHint: Weekly cohorts: share of users returning, relative to cohort size.
admin.webJourneyHint: Which screens users open, how far they get in the wizard, and what they do next.
admin.guideTourHint: Whether real users actually reach each guide, close it themselves, or sit through idle reactivation.

billing.title: Billing
billing.failedText: We could not charge your card — access is still on. Update the payment to keep the subscription.
billing.canceledText: Access stays until {{date}}, then the free plan takes over.
billing.canceledTextNoDate: Access stays until the end of the paid period.
billing.cancelConfirm: Access stays until {{date}}. Turn off auto-renewal?
billing.oneTimeText: No auto-renewal — you will not be charged again. Access stays yours.
billing.oneTimeUntil: Access runs until {{date}}. There is no auto-renewal.

blocked.title: Your account is blocked
blocked.tiktokReuse: The TikTok account you connected has already been used in Blast — on a different account. All accounts linked to it are therefore blocked.
blocked.tiktokReuseWhy: The per-track unlimited allowance is unlocked by connecting TikTok, and each TikTok account unlocks it once. Holding several accounts as one person is the breach itself, so the block covers all of them, not only the latest one (section 9 of the Terms).
blocked.generic: The account is blocked for breaching the service rules.
blocked.appeal: Think this is a mistake? Write to us and we will look into it:

simple.notFoundText: This page does not exist or the link has expired.
simple.errorText: Refresh the page or come back a little later.

projects.noViewsYet: Views show up once the videos go live on TikTok
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" together with all its videos? This cannot be undone.
projects.unarchived: Project is back in the feed
projects.archiveNote: The track limit is not freed up: it counts uploaded tracks, not projects.

projectModal.title: New project
projectModal.coverFormat: Choose a PNG or JPG file
projectModal.planLine: Plan: {{tier}} · {{left}} of {{total}} generations left this month
projectModal.offer: I accept the terms and consent to data processing
projectModal.paymentMockText: In real mode this redirects to TBank.
projectModal.coverFailed: Project created, but the cover failed to upload
projectModal.whatIsProject: A project is one track and every video made from it.
projectModal.trackFormat: An audio file is required: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC
projectModal.trackReady: Track is in — you will not upload it again in the wizard
projectModal.nameFromTrack: Name taken from the file — feel free to edit
projectModal.coverExplain: This is the project card image. It never goes into the videos — the TikTok cover is a frame you pick when posting.

projectDetail.previewEmpty: Videos will show up here after the first generation

stats.title: Statistics
stats.insightHint: {{count}} videos with your own sources beat the rest
stats.leadingHint: “{{value}}” gets {{lift}}% more than the rest. Measured across {{videos}} published clips — parameter by parameter, not as a bundle
stats.noSignalHint: Across {{videos}} published clips no parameter showed a real gap. That is an answer too: it is not the settings — change something bigger
stats.verdictBlockedHint: These parameters always travelled together, so their contributions cannot be separated. Split them in the next batch
stats.iterationHint: We'll keep the sources and test new subtitles
stats.iterationHintBlocked: We'll keep what worked and split “{{dimension}}” — its contribution cannot be isolated right now
stats.iterationNeedsBatch: Create and publish a baseline batch first
stats.collectingNothingText: Only published clips can be compared: views and reactions come from TikTok after a clip goes live.
stats.collectingSameTitle: Every published clip uses the same settings
stats.collectingSameText: More of the same will not help — there is nothing to compare. Make a batch where exactly one thing changes: at least {{count}} clips per variant.
stats.collectingLeftText: Once each value has {{count}} clips, we will show what actually worked: footage, subtitles or the hook — each on its own, not as a bundle.

track.timingHint: Set the start and end time — minutes and seconds, ms optional
track.guideText: Set the start and end of the segment in mm:ss:ms — minutes, seconds and milliseconds, two digits each. Milliseconds are optional.
track.audioOnly: Only audio files are allowed here: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC
track.segmentCapTrial: On the trial a snippet is up to {{seconds}}s, on a paid plan up to {{paid}}s.
track.segmentOver: {{seconds}}s is over the {{max}}s limit. Move the end point.
track.segmentBackwards: The end must come after the start.

text.lockedHint: Pick the segment timing first — then type the lines that play in it.
text.placeholder: The lines that play in the selected segment.
text.hint: Write it the way it is sung — one line per row
text.resetText: Type the lyrics of the new segment — otherwise subtitles drift from the audio.
text.guideText: Enter only the lines that play inside the selected segment.

bg.heading: Choose background
bg.guideModeText: Switch the format to fit the video idea; you can combine several at once.
bg.guidePoolText: Choose source types: each can be multiplied into as many videos as you need.
bg.guideColorText: Use white, black, or set your own shade on the color bar.
bg.formatHint: This background stays {{format}}. A batch may contain different formats.

fx.title: FX
fx.hintSound: Your sound: riser, reese, voice — plays in the first seconds, before the drop
fx.hintObject: A shape flies in on beat at the cut before the drop
fx.hintEffects: Visual FX: an effect on the drop, a transition between clips and a color grade
fx.hintMotion: A «what to do» cue with a hand or head movement
fx.hintThought: A short AI voice insert before the drop
fx.hintNoHook: A video without an opening hook: choose a transition; styling is optional.
fx.dropNeedsClip: Pick a fragment of the track first — drop candidates are found inside it.
fx.dropAnalyzing: Analysing drop moments in the fragment…
fx.dropManualOnly: No automatic candidates — set the drop timing manually.
fx.dropOutsideClip: The drop timing must be inside the selected clip.
fx.scopeLocked: This style always covers the whole video
fx.guideDropText: Mark the drop or hook moment in the track — effects fire there.
fx.guideTypeText: Each type is its own engagement trick for the first seconds of the drop. You can set up several.
fx.guideWorkzoneTitle: Tune the hook in the work zone
fx.guideWorkzoneText: The transition, style and a preview of each option live right here, on the right.
fx.guideTimelineTitle: Build the video on the timeline
fx.guideTimelineText: Cuts already follow the track tempo. Set a transition on every cut, the hook on the drop and styles on the shots you want.

subs.title: Subtitles
subs.guideFitText: Words are aligned to the track automatically — shift the timing or mark a focus word if needed.
subs.guideStyleText: You can pick several — each goes to its own share of videos at the Pool stage. Every style has its own text settings.
subs.lyricsPlaceholder: The segment text will appear after the first step

customization.title: Text settings
customization.description: Each style has its own settings: pick it with a tab. The example on the right updates instantly.
customization.fontLockedBrat: Brat uses a fixed font — Arial Narrow
customization.fontInvalid: The selected font is not available for {{styles}} — pick another one
customization.accentHint: Focus words in lowercase accent font
customization.heightSerifOnly: Letter height can only be changed for serif fonts
customization.pickStyleFirst: Pick a subtitle style above — each style has its own settings

timeline.windowClamped: The track ends at {{at}} — the clip window was shortened to that point.
timeline.weakWords: Poorly aligned: {{words}}. Check the fragment text and the clip window — subtitles may drift here otherwise.
timeline.title: Subtitle fitting
timeline.idleHint: Pick the clip window and lyrics on the “Track” step — words will show up here
timeline.hint: Drag a word to shift its timing, drag its edges to change duration. Click selects a word; double-click or the Focus button makes it the accent in subtitles. While dragging, the word start snaps to the beat.

subs.guideTextText: Switch styles with the tabs — each has its own font, size and colors.

fxv.guideVariantsText: One type can have several variants, each with its own transition and style. In the Pool every variant gets its own share of videos.
fxv.guideDockText: The arrows on the video switch between examples: effects, transitions, styles. Like one? Pick it in the strip below.
fxv.guideFooterText: Switch between variants here. “+” copies the current one — change its style or transition.

pool.guideTotalText: Raise the counter — the more videos, the wider the coverage of backgrounds, hooks and subtitles.
pool.guideDistributeText: Set how many videos go to each background, hook and style — or press “Distribute”.
pool.guideTotalTextVariants: Raise the counter — more videos means more combinations of backgrounds, subtitles and FX variants.
pool.guideDistributeTextVariants: Every video is a background, a subtitle style and an FX variant. Set how many videos each one gets, or press “Distribute”. The result shows up in “Combinations”.
pool.fxNoVariants: Set up at least one variant on the FX step
pool.fxIncomplete: One of the variants isn’t finished — complete or remove it on the FX step
pool.bgEmpty: Background pool is empty — go back to «Background».
pool.guideStoryboardText: The real footage of this video, cut on the track tempo. The side arrows step through the shots.
pool.guideReplaceText: «Replace shot» shows other clips of the same vibe, «Done» pins your choice. The dice reshuffles the rest.

page.asrPendingText: Wait a few seconds and press Generate again — your timing edits will make it into the video.
page.saveFailText: Check your connection and try again. The transition was stopped and your data is safe.
page.carriedText: The track, lyrics and timings carried over from the previous batch — you can go straight to the settings. Pick another fragment or text if you need a different take.

sources.title: Upload your own sources:
sources.qrPending: QR appears once the backend issues an upload link
sources.videoOnly: Only video files are allowed here
sources.rules: {{format}} video, 1–600 seconds. Up to 200 MB per file, 50 files / 2 GB per account.
sources.expires: Link expires in 10 minutes, up to 10 files. Uploads will appear here.
sources.selectionHint: Clips play in order; the last clip is trimmed to the video length. Your set replaces the library.
sources.phoneDone: Files uploaded. Return to your computer and add them to the set.
sources.editorHint: Build one or more videos. Clips play from top to bottom inside each video; every video appears separately in the Pool and consumes the number of renders assigned there.
sources.videoPlansHint: Drag clips to reorder them or split a clip into a separate video.
sources.noPlans: Upload the first clip and a video will be created automatically.

preview.example: Recorded example. Your text and color appear in the rendered video.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.audioOnly: Choose an audio file for the Audio option
warmup.videoOnly: Choose a video file for the Video option

fxTimeline.guideLibraryText: Click any row in the library — its example starts playing in the preview on the right.
fxTimeline.guideCutsText: Click the circle between two shots — a window with an example opens. Browse with the arrows or pick from the list: the transition goes on that cut right away.
fxTimeline.guidePaceText: «Sparser», «Auto» or «Denser» — how often the shot changes. «Auto» is exactly what the render computes from the track tempo.
fxTimeline.guideVariantsText: Everything you change on the timeline belongs to the variant in this button. Open the list to switch; «+» adds a new variant.
fxTimeline.guideWatchText: Press ▶ on the preview or Space — the video plays with the track: shots, the hook on the drop, transitions and styles, just like the render.
fxTimeline.guidePlayerText: Arrows ‹ › switch to the neighbouring effects. Like one? Press the button below: it lands on the lane and the preview goes back to your video.
fxTimeline.guideDoneText: Edits save on their own. Press «Done» to go back to FX — you can reopen the timeline any time.

auth.registerSubtitle: Ready to promote a new track with video content?
auth.name: Name
auth.tgOnlyHint: Confirmation arrives in Telegram — no email or password needed.
auth.setupText: We need your name for the contract and video credits. You can change it in the profile any time.
auth.noAccountText: Looks like you have not signed up yet. It is quick: we ask for your name once — it goes on payment documents.
auth.tgHeading: Follow the channel and start the bot
auth.tgText: Subscribe to our Telegram channel and start the bot — you'll get your first free generations and we'll bring you back automatically.
auth.tgExpired: Polling expired. Try reloading the page or checking manually.
auth.tgOkText: Starter credits granted in mock mode.
auth.tgNotYet: Don't see the bot start yet. Open it, tap Start and check again.
auth.googleError: Could not sign in with Google — please try again
auth.googleState: The sign-in link expired — start over
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not set up yet
auth.whyTelegram: The bot pings you when the videos are ready — no need to sit on the tab.
auth.tgBenefit: Get pinged in chat when videos are ready
auth.googleBenefit: One click — your name comes from the account
auth.namesForTelegram: Needed for the Telegram route. Google fills the name in for you.

processing.notFoundText: The link is stale or the generation was not saved. Open the project — finished videos live there.
processing.failedText: Some videos did not render. You can run the batch again — spent credits are returned.
processing.reasonSourceMetadata: The selected source pool was incompatible with the renderer configuration.
processing.reasonCollectionMissing: The selected source collection was not found on the render server.
processing.reasonSolidColor: The render server did not support the selected background color.
processing.reasonUnknown: Rendering stopped without a diagnostic message.
processing.closeTabText: We will ping you on Telegram once the videos are ready — one by one and a summary for the batch.
processing.closeTabTextNoBot: Nothing gets lost: come back to this page or open the project — the finished videos will be there.
processing.step1Text: Finding the drop and the beat grid — every cut is built on them.
processing.step2Text: Words of the snippet get frame-accurate timing.
processing.step3Text: Clips from the library that match the mood and colour.
processing.step4Text: Hooks, transitions and flashes are pinned to the drop.
processing.step5Text: {{size}} output plus the frames for the cover.
processing.guideCaption: how to prepare and publish the video

tiktok.yourBrandHint: Your video will be labeled as 'Promotional content'
tiktok.brandedContentHint: Your video will be labeled as 'Paid partnership'. 'Only me' becomes unavailable
tiktok.brandedPrivateUnavailable: Branded content visibility cannot be set to private
tiktok.noVideosText: Create a batch first. After generation, even a single video can be opened here from its TikTok row action.
tiktok.connectRequiredText: Connect a TikTok account before publishing. You will return to video setup after connecting.
tiktok.postError: Could not send the video to TikTok
tiktok.soonHint: TikTok connection is not open yet — it turns on once TikTok review is passed.

failReason.route_unavailable: Couldn't reach TikTok from our server — the problem is on our side, not with the video. Please try again in a few minutes.
failReason.internal: TikTok couldn't process the video on its side. Please try again in a minute.
failReason.unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_privat: Until TikTok approves Blast, you can only post to a private account. Turn on “Private account” in TikTok settings.
failReason.spam_risk_too_many_posts: TikTok limited the number of posts per day. Please try again later.
failReason.spam_risk_user_banned_from_posting: TikTok has temporarily blocked this account from posting.
failReason.reached_active_user_cap: The daily limit for posting through apps is reached. Please try again tomorrow.
failReason.file_format_check_failed: TikTok didn't accept the file format.
failReason.duration_check_failed: TikTok didn't accept the video duration.
failReason.picture_size_check_failed: TikTok didn't accept the frame size.
failReason.frame_rate_check_failed: TikTok didn't accept the frame rate.
failReason.auth_removed: TikTok access was revoked — please reconnect the account.
failReason.scope_not_authorized: Reconnect TikTok in your profile to allow sending drafts.

trackUsage.title: Where your tracks went
trackUsage.explain: A track is charged to your limit once — the first time you upload it. New clips from the same track don't use your track limit; their videos only use generations.
trackUsage.empty: No tracks charged yet. Your first uploaded track will show up here.
trackUsage.botHint: clips made in the bot aren't listed here
